tasks.definition: Short memory set followed by a probe; yes/no judgment of set membership. RT typically scales linearly with set size.

procedure: Participants memorize a small set of items (1–6 digits or letters), then a probe appears and they indicate whether it was in the memory set.
manipulations: Varied vs. fixed set across trials
measurements: RT as a function of set size (slope = scanning rate, ~38 ms/item)
